followup_reviews.Research finding: The BMA statements preserve cargo suspension on 12 December and normal cargo processing by 16 December. The new 14 December indexed SABC passage describes limited and recurrent processing, not full ordinary-cargo restoration. Retain the existing 12–16 December bound and qualified continuity; no exact duration or first cargo-restoration day is proposed.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 93d638937b99f332a39042e2237773e1773b710f9729ca622f4586f4e6578bc7. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept four new parents/seven phases and two targeted existing-record findings. Adopt the separately read 16 July 2020 Lebombo reopening day, preserving in-yard truck processing and unknown first-passage clocks. Keep Skilpadshek planned and observed episodes separate, Beitbridge generic-table national-side scope qualified, and pandemic curfews intermittent. No new geometry or existing-record timing corrections are approved; all eight evidence issues remain open.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R06-Q02 — First ordinary-cargo restoration, special release windows and exact continuity within 12–16 December are not settled. The distinct later 27 December escorted-cargo event cannot close this earlier spell.
